name: dependency-updates
title: Dependency Updates
description: Triage every open Dependabot and Renovate pull request across your GitHub repositories, grouped by package, and approve, merge or auto-merge a whole group at once
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Dependency Updates
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Browse open Dependabot and Renovate pull requests grouped by package or repository, and approve, merge or auto-merge them in bulk.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Dependency Updates Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Show the number of open dependency update pull requests in the menu bar.

tools.name: list-dependency-updates
tools.title: List Dependency Updates
tools.description: List open Dependabot and Renovate pull requests across the user's GitHub repositories, grouped by package. Optionally filter by package name, CI status or bot.

tools.name: merge-dependency-updates
tools.title: Merge Dependency Updates
tools.description: Approve and merge every open Dependabot or Renovate pull request that updates the given package, across all repositories. By default only pull requests with passing CI and no conflicts are merged.

ai.instructions: Dependency update pull requests are opened by Dependabot or Renovate. When the user asks to merge updates for a package, call list-dependency-updates first if the exact package name is unclear, then call merge-dependency-updates with that package name. Never merge pull requests with failing CI unless the user explicitly asks for it.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: Optional personal access token used instead of signing in with GitHub. Required scopes: repo, read:org.

preferences.name: owners
preferences.title: Owners
preferences.description: Comma-separated users or organizations to search (for example: raycast, 0xdhrv). Leave empty to search your own account and every organization you belong to.

preferences.name: mergeMethod
preferences.title: Merge Method
preferences.description: Preferred merge method. Falls back to a method the repository allows.

preferences.name: additionalAuthors
preferences.title: Additional Bot Authors
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra pull request authors to include, for self-hosted Renovate or custom bots (for example: app/my-renovate, renovate-bot).

preferences.name: treatNoChecksAsPassing
preferences.title: Checks
preferences.label: Treat pull requests without CI checks as passing
preferences.description: When enabled, pull requests in repositories without status checks are included in bulk merges.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
